name: High protein ice cream
identity: High-protein, reduced-sugar ice cream of the supermarket pint, 7 to 11 g protein per 100 g; always flavoured.
rule: Per 100 g, each value is the median of the three labels below that declare it, and a value enters only when at least three labels declare it (flavoured by nature). Salt becomes sodium (salt in g × 400 = sodium in mg). Nothing a label leaves out becomes zero. Labels read on 2026-10-30 from Open Food Facts through Akari's proxy, as the beef protein isolate was.

labels.ingredients: Eingedickte entrahmte Milch, Schlagsahne 4,8%, Inulin, Weizenmehl, Süßungsmittel (Erythrit, Steviolglycoside aus Stevia), Molkeneiweißpulver 3,6%; Zucker, Milcheiweißpulver 2,2%, Margarine (Palmfett, Wasser), Glukosesirup, fettarmes Kakaopulver', Emulgator (Mono - und Diglyceride von Speisefettsäure

labels.product: Salted Caramel High Protein Ice Cream
